title: Titans star ‘jealous as hell’ of Mike Vrabel’s fast Patriots success

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Titans star ‘jealous as hell’ of Mike Vrabel’s fast Patriots success
sources.description: Mike Vrabel took the Patriots on an astonishing run to Super Bowl 2026 in his first season as their head coach, just a year after New England finished last in the AFC East.
